items.title: Cloudflare Develops Public Certificate Authority for Post-Quantum Web Security
items.summaryShort: Cloudflare Develops Public Certificate Authority for Post-Quantum Web Security. Cloudflare is developing a public certificate authority for Merkle Tree Certificates (MTCs) to reduce the bandwidth overhead of post-quantum cryptography.

items.title: Fervo now has $12B in orders for its geothermal power tech
items.summaryShort: Fervo now has $12B in orders for its geothermal power tech. Geothermal company Fervo is targeting natural gas as it brings down geothermal drilling costs at its 8.4 GW resource in Utah.

items.title: YouTube streaming data returns to Billboard charts, ending major disagreement
items.summaryShort: YouTube streaming data returns to Billboard charts, ending major disagreement. YouTube will resume sharing streaming data with Billboard in 2027 after changes to the chart formula give more weight to free, ad-supported music streams.
